always: Mass changes size, not swing speed.

cases.text: Short string or strong g: fast swing
Long string or weak g: slow swing
Near bottom: speed is at its peak.

changes: Chose side-by-side layout with 3-row columns text arrangement so both pictures sit side by side and all explanation lines fit as bullets.
Mapped main stage at 75 px/m with origin at (164, 46) so the full pendulum swing, bob radius, and velocity arrow fit in 304x260.8 px.
Attached pivotLabel above pivotDot and velLabel below velArrow so both labels stay clear of the ceiling, string, and bob circle.
Set startAtEdge true on velArrow so the velocity arrow begins outside the bob circle and its arrowhead never overlaps the bob.
Turned off the panel legend for the single Angle series so the coordinate-plot fits vertically in the 260.8 px tall panel slot.
Shortened Frequency to Freq and Peak speed to Top spd so values fit the 200 px values column, and dropped Angle since the plot shows it.
